description: Fires on the move that completes a named trap's setup (step_label='setup_completed'). v89 (2026-05-25) — Mohit: warn the user when they're the VICTIM of a known trap. trap_color was backfilled across all 43 traps in data/traps.json. V5 now stamps trap_record.user_is_victim based on user_color vs trap_color. New warning variants fire when user_is_victim=true; the existing 'you set up' / 'opp setup' variants still cover the other cases. {trap_description} comes from data/traps.json — adding a new trap = adding a JSON entry there, no edits here.

fact_glossary.trap_name: Authored trap name from data/traps.json (e.g. 'Fried Liver Attack')
fact_glossary.this_move_by_user: true when the user is the one who just played the setup-completing move
fact_glossary.trap_record.user_is_victim: v89 — true when user_color is the OPPOSITE of trap_color (i.e. user is the side that gets punished). Independent of who played the setup move.
fact_glossary.trap_record.next_expected_move: v89 — first move of trap_line, surfaced as the punisher's incoming threat.

variants.victim_warning: {move_san} — watch out, you've walked into {trap_name} territory. The punisher will play {trap_next_expected_move} next.
variants.victim_warning_with_desc: {move_san} — watch out, you've walked into {trap_name} territory. {trap_description} The punisher will play {trap_next_expected_move} next.
variants.victim_warning_no_punish: {move_san} — watch out, you've walked into {trap_name} territory.
variants.victim_warning_no_punish_with_desc: {move_san} — watch out, you've walked into {trap_name} territory. {trap_description}
